subject.title: gateway install/status hardcodes ~/Library/LaunchAgents — prevents boot-without-login on macOS

question: What privileged macOS LaunchDaemon install/status contract should OpenClaw support for gateway services?
rationale: This choice decides sudo behavior, root-owned plist mutation, execution user, durable environment handling, and whether OpenClaw owns system LaunchDaemons or only reports external supervisors.

options.title: Explicit system scope with safe default
options.body: Keep the user LaunchAgent default, add an explicit audited system-scope install/status path, and align doctor/lifecycle/docs/tests before implementation.

options.title: Diagnostic guidance only
options.body: Do not manage system LaunchDaemons yet; make status/doctor accurately report them and guide operators to manual launchctl commands.

options.title: Full managed LaunchDaemon lifecycle
options.body: Add first-class install/status/start/stop/uninstall support for LaunchDaemons and accept the larger privileged-service surface after owner review.

recommendation.title: Explicit system scope with safe default
recommendation.body: Keep the user LaunchAgent default, add an explicit audited system-scope install/status path, and align doctor/lifecycle/docs/tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest feature-history signal for the gateway service adapter and launchd helper boundary that this decision would change.
